name: @mica-js/example-ct107d
description: CT107D 竞赛板示例：v2 正式文档、融合器件、工作台宿主与 legacy oracle

scripts.build: node device/scripts/build-mcu.mjs && node device/scripts/generate.mjs && mica build --root device && node scripts/document.mjs --check && node scripts/workbench.mjs build
scripts.build:fused: node device/scripts/build-mcu.mjs && node device/scripts/generate.mjs && mica build --root device
scripts.workbench:dev: node device/scripts/build-mcu.mjs && node device/scripts/generate.mjs && mica build --root device && node scripts/workbench.mjs dev
scripts.build:legacy: node ../devices/scripts/for-each-device.mjs build && mica build && node build-schematic.mjs && node build-canvas.mjs
scripts.check:fused: node assemble-firmware.mjs --check && node device/scripts/build-mcu.mjs && node device/scripts/generate.mjs --check
scripts.typecheck: mica prepare --root device && tsc -p device/tsconfig.json --noEmit && mica prepare && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: node ../devices/scripts/for-each-device.mjs build && node device/scripts/build-mcu.mjs && node device/scripts/generate.mjs && mica build --root device && vitest run
scripts.test:workbench: node ../devices/scripts/for-each-device.mjs build && node device/scripts/build-mcu.mjs && node device/scripts/generate.mjs && mica build --root device && vitest run test/workbench*.test.ts test/document*.test.ts
scripts.bench: node ../devices/scripts/for-each-device.mjs build && node device/scripts/build-mcu.mjs && node device/scripts/generate.mjs && mica build --root device && vitest run --config vitest.perf.config.ts
scripts.schematic: node ../devices/scripts/for-each-device.mjs build && mica build && node verify-schematic.mjs
scripts.canvas: node ../devices/scripts/for-each-device.mjs build && mica build && node verify-canvas.mjs
